title: The Three Voices Inside You
coreMove: Hear which ego state is speaking before you answer the content of the sentence.
sourcePressure: Teaches Parent, Adult, and Child as observable ego states, including Critical/Nurturing Parent, Free/Adapted Child, contamination, exclusion, and unchosen state shifts.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Parent, Adult, and Child as fixed personality types or a pop inner-child metaphor instead of live behavioral states.

sourceAnchors.name: Parent-Adult-Child ego-state model
sourceAnchors.detail: the source defines three observable behavioral states: Parent from authority figures, Adult as present-tense reality processing, and Child as childhood feeling and adaptation still active in adults
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Parent, Adult, and Child are not three people inside you; they are three registers a single sentence can wear.

sourceAnchors.name: contamination and exclusion
sourceAnchors.detail: the source notes that problems arise when one ego state masquerades as another or when a state is cut off from use
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A prejudice can arrive dressed as an Adult fact, and a fear can arrive dressed as caution.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: hospital shift handoff after a medication near-miss
exampleSpecs.audience: a charge nurse deciding how to respond to a junior nurse who asks a clean dosage question
exampleSpecs.stakes: patient safety, shame, and whether the room stays factual
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sarah hears her own first reply start as data and end as scolding, stops before the last clause, and restates the dose check in Adult language.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Can I ask why the order changed from 5 to 2.5?" hangs over the nurses station.

exampleSpecs.domain: Paris product design critique for a flawed checkout screen
exampleSpecs.audience: a design lead whose feedback can either teach the interface problem or shame the designer
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the junior designer learns the pattern or only learns to hide draft work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Camille points to the abandoned-cart data instead of saying the designer should have known better.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The projector throws a pale checkout form across the glass wall.

exampleSpecs.domain: family group text about an elderly parent's appointment
exampleSpecs.audience: an adult son pulled between practical scheduling and old sibling rank
exampleSpecs.stakes: a simple appointment can become a childhood argument in six messages
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Thomas notices that his thumbs are answering his sister from the twelve-year-old who hated being corrected, then writes the appointment time only.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You are holding the phone over the kitchen counter while three gray dots blink.

exampleSpecs.domain: tenant association budget meeting in a cold community room
exampleSpecs.audience: a volunteer treasurer trying to stay in Adult while an older member speaks in Parent rules
exampleSpecs.stakes: a repair fund vote may fail because the tone pulls everyone backward
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Anke separates the member's rule-tone from the useful number hidden inside it and asks for the invoice date.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The room smells of wet coats and copier toner before anyone sits down.

exampleSpecs.domain: youth football sideline after a missed penalty kick
exampleSpecs.audience: a coach whose comfort can still come from Parent if it tells the player what to feel
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a child gets present information or a borrowed script about toughness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Diego sees that his gentle line still commands the child to feel proud, then asks what the player noticed about his plant foot.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Diego until the second missed kick to hear the order inside his kindness.

exampleSpecs.audience: a legal-aid coordinator trying not to let an applicant's panic become her own Parent rescue script
exampleSpecs.stakes: one wrong tone can turn an adult client into someone being managed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Aanya notices the urge to soothe and instead names the next document needed in present-tense terms.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: What changes when a kind voice starts telling someone how they should feel?

skillTargets: distinguish ego state from personality type
identify Adult data-handling versus Parent rule-giving
spot contamination in a plausible sentence
recognize that state shifts are usually noticed before they are controlled

tryThisNowSpec: Replay one sentence from a tense exchange today and label only its state: Parent rule, Adult data, or Child reaction. Do not solve it yet.
